title: A DEAD CRAWLER LEAVES WRECKAGE, NOT A BOX
why: His note: it would be cool if it showed wreckage instead, same for other enemy deaths. A dead Crawler left the generic brown wreck. It now lies on its back as the crawler: the three rust shell segments cracked open, its six legs curled up in the air and snapped, the gunmetal sensor head fallen off with three dead eyes and a mandible blade. Smoke while unsearched. Looting is unchanged.
now: A dead Crawler lies on its back, smoking.
